title: GeneSpeak-FP: Target and Compound Retrieval from Observed Cell-Level Perturbation Signatures
abstract: arXiv:2607.17671v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Single-cell perturbation profiles may help identify known compounds across cellular contexts. We present GeneSpeak-FP, a gene-token Transformer that jointly ranks recorded compounds and their target annotations from a treated cell relative to a cell-line-specific DMSO reference, together with a coarse organ token. On Tahoe-100M, we split 11,673 drug--cell-line groups 90/10 within each compound. No complete group is shared across partitions, although compound and cell-line identities may recur. In a 38,400-query Monte Carlo pass, the correct compound appears first for 12.9% of cells and within the top 10 for 34.3%, among 379 fixed candidates. The model retrieves 40.8% of annotated targets within the top 10 and 54.4% within the top 20, from a vocabulary of 278 genes. Top-10 compound retrieval and target recall are approximately 13 and 11 times their expected values under uniformly random rankings; top-1 compound retrieval is nearly 49

translated_title: GeneSpeak-FP：从观测到的细胞水平扰动特征中检索靶点与化合物
translated_abstract: 单细胞扰动谱可能有助于在不同细胞背景下识别已知化合物。我们提出了GeneSpeak-FP，这是一个基因标记Transformer模型，它基于处理后的细胞相对于细胞系特异性DMSO参考的表达变化，并结合一个粗粒度的器官标记，联合对记录的化合物及其靶点注释进行排序。在Tahoe-100M数据集上，我们在每种化合物内部将11,673个药物-细胞系组按90/10比例划分，尽管化合物和细胞系的身份可能重复出现，但没有任何完整的组在划分之间共享。在38,400次查询的蒙特卡洛评估中，在379个固定候选化合物中，正确化合物在12.9%的细胞中排名第一，在34.3%的细胞中位列前10。该模型从278个基因的词表中，在top 10内检索到40.8%的注释靶点，在top 20内检索到54.4%。Top-10化合物检索和靶点召回率分别约为均匀随机排序下期望值的13倍和11倍；top-1化合物检索接近49倍。
tldr: 提出GeneSpeak-FP，一种基因标记Transformer模型，可从单细胞扰动特征中联合检索化合物及其靶点，其top-10化合物检索和靶点召回率分别达到随机排序期望值的约13倍和11倍。
en_tdlr: GeneSpeak-FP is a gene-token Transformer that jointly retrieves compounds and their annotated targets from observed single-cell perturbation signatures, achieving top-10 compound retrieval and target recall approximately 13 and 11 times above random expectation.
